title: You Think You Can Ignore Printed Words, Yet Clashing Ink Slows Every Reader Down
description:
You think focus can easily switch off reading! Yet clashing ink jams every fluent reader's mouth! This is the true story of John Ridley Stroop's color test. Here is what went wrong with simple speed theories.
